editorial: Editorial, not any college's requirement: for each major family (two-digit CIP, lib/majors.ts), the high school subjects that colleges and professional bodies commonly expect, written from the pages listed under `sources` and shown as "commonly expected", never as what a particular college requires (the colleges' own required courses are in data/major-admission.json). `top` is the catalog course (data/reference/ap-courses.json) that reaches the expected level in that subject; the course plan (specs/chances/course-plan.md) uses it for the path a 9th or 10th grader sees and for the "your intended major" reason. Reviewed in data PRs. The pages could not be opened from the build environment (the proxy blocks college sites); `verified_via: "search"` marks a statement read in a web search result from the page, to be re-read on the page itself at the next data run.
